simple.meaning: זָעַק (zâʻaq) appears 73 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Exodus, Joshua, Judges, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 17 more, beginning at Exodus 2:23. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, death, kingship, city, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זָעַק (H2199) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows זָעַק through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: זָעַק (zâʻaq) / H2199 is tracked through Exodus 2:23, Joshua 8:16, Judges 3:9, Judges 3:15. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
